messages:
samir: Running into a weird gap between our async client stubs and runtime retry behavior. The typed AsyncClient.post signature in typeshed doesn't accept `idempotency_key` or `headers`, but runtime accepts headers via **kwargs. Mypy completely misses it so CI is noisy.

samir: Repro: mypy error in sample-app when I try `await client.post('/v1/items', json=payload, headers={'Idempotency-Key': key})` because stub shows no headers param.

lee_sdk: that's a bug in our py.ipa typing package. We historically meant to mirror sync API but the async overloads diverged during a refactor.

nia_sre: separate but related: noticed the async client retry loop will replay POSTs on 500 even with no idempotency header. That caused duplicate DB entries during a load test.

rachel: is this only for 500s? what about 502/503?

nia_sre: all 5xx by default are retried by our middleware. It doesn't check method type or idempotency header.

samir: my opinion: typings parity first (add headers & idempotency_key to async stubs). Then change retry policy: default should not retry non-idempotent methods (POST/PATCH/DELETE) unless idempotency provided or client configured with unsafe_retries=True.

lee_sdk: agreed. We can add a runtime check in retry middleware: if method in NON_IDEMPOTENT and not idempotency header and not client.auto_idempotency: raise RetryDeferredError or return response without retry.

rachel: don't break existing customers who expect retries though. Maybe a feature-flagged rollout: default keep current behavior but warn in logs and emit a deprecation header. Then switch default in a minor release.

samir: we should also expose a typed `RetryPolicy` dataclass in top-level package so people can configure backoff/jitter/retry_after behavior with proper types. Current config is a dict blob in docs.

lee_sdk: plan: (1) Add `headers: Optional[Dict[str,str]] = None` and `idempotency_key: Optional[str] = None` kwargs to async client call signatures in stubs. (2) Wire idempotency_key into headers at runtime (prefer explicit header when both set). (3) Update retry middleware to honor `Retry-After` if present and respect RetryPolicy. (4) Add `client.auto_idempotency: bool = False` toggle and a deprecation opt-in to keep old behavior. (5) Add clear exception RetryDeferredError with helpful message.

nia_sre: tests: add unit tests mocking server that returns 201 then 500 and ensure single resource created when idempotency header used. Also add integration test for honoring `Retry-After` header. We saw a 503 with Retry-After: 3 and client retried immediately which made things worse.

rachel: typing: add example in README and update quickstart sample-app to use new RetryPolicy dataclass. Also ensure autosynth tests run mypy against stubs.

lee_sdk: I'll open a PR with typing changes + middleware change behind a feature flag. Will include release notes and migration guidance.

ci-bot: Created PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1299 with labels devex, typing, p2. Tests queued.

samir: small UX ask: when we auto-generate idempotency keys for users, include a human-readable prefix like `redwood-auto-<uuid>` so logs traceable.

lee_sdk: good idea. also will add a short warning when auto-generated keys are used if client has debug log enabled.

nia_sre: ping for perf team: ensure auto-idempotency doesn't break our KV cache assumptions (prefix caching).

samir: thanks team. Will validate PR in sample-app and switch mypy config to be stricter once merged.

ci-bot: PR merged: 1769600287
